## Summary

Describe the change and the user or developer outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `python3 hatch.py --self-test`
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when behavior changed

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] The atlas/manifest contract is unchanged, or all consumers and tests were updated
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, generated pets, local workflows, or signed asset URLs are included
- [ ] New network behavior validates destinations and bounds responses
